newsitem.title: USA: NorAm Gaming to acquire Venezuela casino.
newsitem.headline: NorAm Gaming to acquire Venezuela casino.

text.p: NorAm Gaming and Entertainment said it signed a letter of intent for purchase of a gaming casino in Porlarmar, Margarita Island, Venezuela.
NorAm said the casino is situated on eight acres, allowing for future expansion, and will give it its first casino in the Caribbean Islands.
NorAm will pay $1.875 million for the casino. The casino will provide patrons with a full compliment of table games, slot machines, a floor show area, two cocktail lounges and parking for 300 cars.
The purchase of the casino is subject to further due diligence by the management of NorAm Gaming and Entertainment and such due diligence will begin onsite at the casino November 30.
